chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Abū Yaḥyā al-Ṣanʿānī, who said:

I was in the presence of Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام when his son Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام was brought, while he was still young. So he said: "This is the newborn such that no newborn has been born with greater blessing upon our Shiʿah than him."

key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا: Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā, the Imam speaking in this report
key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the young son being referred to in the narration
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: our Shiʿah, the followers devoted to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام say about the birth of Imam al-Jawād عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith reports Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام identifying his young son Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام as an extraordinarily blessed child for the Shiʿah. It highlights the special significance of Imam al-Jawād عليه السلام in the line of Imamate and preserves an early testimony to his blessed status.
